Team — quick thoughts on the commercial split:

- Platform fee amortization: recommended to give Nebula a 24-month amortization for the platform fee over a 36-month minimum commitment. That lowers upfront cost and aligns with their capital planning.
- Support retainer: keep as monthly, tiered by oncall coverage (Standard / Enhanced / 24x7). For regulated workloads we should push Enhanced (monthly + per-incident top-up).
- Escrow: keep triggers tight. We can accept bankruptcy and 180-day remediation as triggers, but ask to add an operational fallback: if we declare an intent-to-sell/transfer, escrow can be accessed only with joint approval of both parties or a court order. Prevents premature transfers.

Sean — can you add 2 bullets in the SOW about runbook handover format and an ops war-room cadence (30/60/90 days post-prod)? That will make legal comfortable.

Olga — I'll prepare a pricing counter with amortized rows and an option table (pilot add-on, production nodes). Recommend a 12% net discount off list if they sign within two weeks.
